mapper.select: SELECT SQL_SEQ, SQL_PARAM_NO, PARAM, PARAM_DESC, SQL_PARAM_TP, DEFAULT_VAL, SORT_CD, USE_YN, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY FROM SY_SQL_PARAM WHERE SQL_SEQ = #{sqlSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY SORT_CD ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SY_SQL_PARAM WHERE SQL_SEQ = #{sqlSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
